trajectory_summary: The call opens hostile and stays adversarial for most of its length, with the customer running an extended, unscripted legitimacy audit that the rep never fully closes — she survives it through personal rapport and transparency rather than resolving the substance. Energy builds only in the final third once the customer narrows her trust to Meg personally and a time gets set, but the booking is fragile: co-owner Andy is explicitly excluded and the bill was never actually sent.
outcome_dispute: V1 tag is unknown; observed behavior supports a tentative/conditional booking, not a clean book — the appointment depends on Meg personally attending and Andy remains unconfirmed.
